purpose: A bar missing its high and a bar with a non-positive price make the input invalid; the detector rejects the bar-set and produces no geometry (INVALID_INPUT / INVALID_PRICE).

params.eps_break_note: eps_break is illustrative, not locked (HD-03, §13.5); versioned/backtestable. It is never consulted in this fixture: the §18 input guards reject the bar-set before any line exists, so the outcome is invariant under every value of eps_break and no sweep is recorded.
params.formation_params_note: Formation gates are first-class, k-independent, versioned parameters (§21.3, D-TL-12): min_formation_bars replaces the pivot-derived 2k+2 and min_ath_age_bars replaces the k-recency window. Numerically unchanged at k=3.

expected_second_anchor.reason: Geometry is not fit: the input guards of §18 reject the bar-set (INVALID_INPUT, INVALID_PRICE) before anchoring or fitting.

rejection_rationale.candidate: Fitting any line at any prefix
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: The §18 input guards reject the bar-set before anchoring or fitting, so no as-of-time line exists at any bar and no tolerance is ever consulted.

key_inequalities: Input guard (§18) fires before geometry: INVALID_INPUT, INVALID_PRICE. No prefix S_t ever yields a line, so §21 evaluation never begins.
geometry_check.notes: Unchanged by the causal audit: input validity is checked before any prefix is evaluated, so no as-of-time line exists at any bar.

causal_record.semantics: As-of-time (rolling causal) evaluation per §21 / HD-12 / D-TL-11. Every value below is derived ONLY from bars strictly earlier than the bar it judges; no expectation here uses a full-series hull.
causal_record.note: Input guards (§18) reject the bar-set before any geometry is fitted, so no as-of-time line exists at any prefix.
